text:
Tara Lin: Hi all  second day here. My laptop came but the USB-C to Ethernet adapter that was supposed to be in the box is missing. I'm on a flaky hotel Wi-Fi and need wired for the first-week onboarding sessions. Who handles spare adapters?

Devon Cruz: Welcome Tara! @Ops usually handles spares. Quick question: do you also have a company docking station or just the laptop kit?

Tara Lin: Just the laptop kit. Packing list shows 'USB-C Ethernet Adapter (RJ45)'. Checked the box twice  not there. Desk is B1-02.

Devon Cruz: OK I'll ping Ops and create a ticket. In the meantime if you can tether to your phone that's a workaround.

it-bot: New ticket created: IT-6021 - "Missing USB-C Ethernet adapter for new-hire kit". Assigned to Ops. ETA for same-day desk drop: 3 hours if available.

Ops: We have a few spare adapters (asset ADP-442, ADP-443). Can someone from ops drop by at 14:30? Also confirming desk B1-02.

Tara Lin: 14:30 is perfect, thanks!

Devon Cruz: If the adapter arrives but doesn't link, try `ifconfig` (macOS) or `ipconfig /all` (Windows) to see if the NIC shows up. Some adapters need a firmware refresh but usually they're plug-and-play.

Ops: Dropped by at 14:27 with ADP-443 and left a sticky with asset tag. Plugged into Tara's MacBook  ethernet link light up on the switch. Verified IP via `ifconfig` (en5): IPv4 10.12.4.82. Left the adapter with Tara.

Tara Lin: Confirmed working  wired network connected and onboarding Zooms ran fine. Thank you!

Devon Cruz: Awesome. I'll mark IT-6021 resolved and update asset log for ADP-443. If you notice any drops DM me and we'll swap to ADP-442. :white_check_mark:

it-bot: Ticket IT-6021 status changed to RESOLVED by Devon Cruz on 1780000150.
